data.title: 三司绫濑 · 浅浪沙滩的贝壳拾趣
data.description: 傍晚微凉的海风卷来一层层白色细浪，绫濑赤脚蹲在湿润的浅滩边，惊喜地拾起一枚带着珠光的淡粉小贝壳举到眼前细看。珊瑚粉褶皱泳裙边被海风轻拂，她扬起笑脸喊你快看这枚像极了珍珠胸针的小贝壳。
data.location: 白浪轻拍的黄昏细沙滩边缘
data.action: 赤脚蹲在浅浪边高举拾到的贝壳，回头展露惊喜笑容
data.lighting: 柔和暖金斜阳洒满湿沙与浅浪反光
data.camera: 微俯中全身，捕捉蹲姿与浅浪泡沫动感
data.mood: 纯真、欣喜、毫无伪装的明朗
data.promptProse: Crouching barefoot where gentle white foam washes over wet sand, Ayase holds up a pearlescent pink seashell she just discovered and beams toward the viewer. Warm late-afternoon sun illuminates the delicate pearl center accent and ruffled mesh skirt of her coral-pink bandeau bikini.
data.animaCaption: Crouching barefoot at the edge of gentle waves, she holds up a pearlescent seashell with a delighted smile.
